About the Community

blocks.text: Arista — Hayer Homes Townhomes at 156 Street and Mountain View Drive

parts.t: Arista

is a community of 65 three-level townhomes by Hayer Homes at 2955 156 Street, at 156 Street and Mountain View Drive in Grandview Surrey. It was completed in 2011 and has a clubhouse and a guest suite for residents.

The Shops at Morgan Crossing and Grandview Corners are each about 1 km away. Arista is in the Sunnyside Elementary and Grandview Heights Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator). Another Grandview Surrey townhome community with its own guide is
Fox & Aikins North
, built by Park Ridge Homes.
Arista sits on a quiet, no-through road, with landscaped common areas between the buildings.
Sunnyside Elementary and Grandview Heights Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator)

blocks.text: Room to Live, Space to Grow

parts.t: Arista townhomes are about 1,200 to 1,500 square feet over three levels. Main floors have 10-foot ceilings, large windows, an electric fireplace and wide-plank laminate floors, and kitchens have granite countertops and stainless steel appliances.
Upper levels hold the bedrooms, and homes have patios or decks for outdoor space.
Strata & Ownership
Arista is registered as strata plan BCS4082. Confirm what the monthly fees include, and review the bylaws, depreciation report and minutes before you write an offer.
Prices vary by unit and change with the market. Contact Jared for recent Arista sales and current listings.

What is the price range for Arista Townhomes in South Surrey?
Prices vary by unit and change with the market. Contact Jared for recent Arista sales and current listings.
How large are the homes at Arista?
Arista townhomes are about 1,200 to 1,500 square feet over three levels. Contact Jared for the bedroom count and exact size of a specific unit.
Are pets allowed at Arista Townhomes?

Most strata bylaws at Arista permit pets with reasonable size and quantity restrictions. Always confirm current pet bylaws with the strata management company before purchasing, particularly if you have larger dogs or multiple animals.
What schools serve Arista in South Surrey?

Arista is in the Sunnyside Elementary and Grandview Heights Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator). Southridge School, an independent K-12 school, is at 2656 160 Street.
How competitive is the Arista market?
It depends on the unit and the market at the time. Contact Jared for recent Arista sales and comparable listings before you price or make an offer.
Are there homes for sale at Arista right now?
Listings at Arista come and go quickly. Check the South Surrey townhome search above, or call or text me at 604-928-1361 and I'll set up an alert for new Arista listings.
What should I check before buying at Arista?
Ask for the Form B information certificate, the strata bylaws and rules, the last two years of minutes and the depreciation report. I review these with every buyer before subjects are removed.
